note: Hand-labelled corpus of VERIFIED prose defects in agent-harness-JA. Ground truth is high-confidence: each was found by review, confirmed, and corrected in the named commit. `clause` is the defective assertion; `line_has_citation` records whether the physical line it lived on carried a backticked identifier / file:line / 'verified <date>', which is what issue #61's proposed rule keys on.

defects.clause: The key has nowhere safe to live. The only placement that reaches the write path is `./.harness/`.
defects.why: src/cli.ts passes userDir: homedir() into the same command; a trusted placement exists.

defects.clause: `:memory:` is used by tests
defects.why: It is used by every `harness eval` run, not only tests.

defects.clause: three independent objections
defects.why: One objection supplied another's trigger; only two were independent.

defects.clause: zero digest rows anywhere
defects.why: Evidenced by a single database; 'anywhere' is not established.

defects.clause: absence means the row predates the field
defects.why: True only on rows where pathTruncated is true; stated unconditionally.

defects.clause: a keyed digest would make the raw-versus-escaped choice stop mattering
defects.why: That choice rests on ICU stability, which keying does not touch. Reached main.

defects.clause: reported a band seven characters wider than the real one
defects.why: Six, under the synthesis's own fixture. Seven is the TRUE band width stated 20 lines earlier.

defects.clause: the client or project directory outlives the username by the whole width of the home path
defects.why: Margin is user.length + clientDir.length - 1 (14), not home.length (13). Was wrong in THREE files; fixed in one first.

defects.clause: That is the same position issue #53 was in a fortnight earlier
defects.why: Two days. Contradicted by security-model.md dating the panel 2026-07-29.

defects.clause: digests as shipped today:      differ
defects.why: Printed fixtures were 46/34 chars, under the 1023 cap, where the function returns early with NO digest.

defects.clause: Rejected for the reason ADR-0013 already gives for excluding an unanchored generic rule: paths are not secrets, the false-positive surface is very large, and `resultSummary` exists to be readable.
defects.why: ADR-0013 gives ONE reason (over-matches code-heavy tool output). The other two are this ADR's own.

defects.clause: four further channels are now enumerated as R-17
defects.why: R-17 enumerates five, in the same commit.

defects.clause: It must either record the home value in the row alongside the transformed text, so a reader can tell whether the transform applied and to what, or take the home directory as an explicit operator argument with no environment default.
defects.why: Recording the home value in the row IS the disclosure R-17 exists to name.

defects.clause: so `relative()` closes it without consulting `os.homedir()` at all. There is therefore no ambient value to be silently wrong about
defects.why: process.cwd() is ambient. The true claim is that cwd cannot be well-formed but WRONG the way $HOME can.
Partly closed. relative() walks up to the common ancestor, so the home dir survives when cwd is not at or above the task dir.

defects.clause: the mixed-population problem that makes ADR-0011 item 16 demand a NEW FIELD NAME for a changed meaning does not arise here
defects.why: Item 16 is about an intolerant READ path, not distinguishability. A golden scorecard has no read path, which is a stronger reason.

defects.clause: measured on this machine, 11 of 11 golden scorecards on disk contained the operator's home directory
defects.why: 22 of 22. The sweep covered .harness/eval/ only and missed examples/repo-qa/.harness/eval/.

defects.clause: The #59 channels carry paths incidentally inside prose the harness did not author, which is exactly why they had nothing to key on but an ambient value.
defects.why: (c) and (d) ARE harness-authored prose interpolating an operator-supplied glob.

defects.clause: it('never consults the environment, so a changed HOME cannot alter it', () => {
defects.why: Passes for an implementation reading process.env.HOME on every call.

defects.clause: (b) is **unconditional and per run**, making it a higher-frequency disclosure than the conditional one #59 was filed about, and it is named by neither #59 nor R-16
defects.why: Left in the present tense in the same commit that closed (b), so the row contradicted itself.
